nodes.label: 90-Day Execution Plan (free MVP to first 50 paying customers)
Merchant-of-Record default (Paddle/Lemon Squeezy) for global USD billing
nodes.rationale: An India-registered Stripe account cannot cleanly sell USD subscriptions to US/UK customers (Stripe India is INR-first; RBI export rules apply). MoR is seller of record, handles global tax, pays an Indian bank — no foreign entity needed at ~5% + fees.

nodes.label: Money rail: hosted checkout → webhook writes plan/planRenewsAt onto NextAuth/Mongo user; getPlan(userId) helper
nodes.rationale: Everything downstream hinges on whether lazybull can take money from a US card; zero payment code exists today, so the rail (provider → sandbox charge → webhook → plan:'pro') is the Week-1 priority and reuses existing next-auth@5 + @auth/mongodb-adapter rails.

nodes.label: Free-tier hard limits: 5 AI explanations/day, 3 saved Bet Builder positions, 1 saved Quant workspace, unlimited paper trades
nodes.rationale: Numbers not vibes — gates exactly 3 surfaces (Bet Builder save/AI-narrate, Quant workspace save, /api/explain daily cap) while keeping all 14 Learn chapters and paper trading free as the funnel.

nodes.label: Day-56 kill/pivot criterion: fewer than 5 paying strangers AND trial→paid below 8% triggers hard diagnosis week
nodes.rationale: A plan without a kill criterion is a hope; if the gate fails, the problem is positioning or the paywall surface, not feature count.
